description: A part built without a fit profile (a nominal preview) validated against example-mk4s-petg-0.4: its mesh has none of the offsets, so the report would describe another part: blocker.

findings.fix: build the part again with fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` before exporting it
findings.message: the part was built without a fit profile but is validated against fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4`, so its mesh has none of that profile's offsets
